watches.name: Signature - ice blue/silver
watches.description: Description CLASSIC DESIGN WITH MODERN FEATURES: Get ready to get a lot of attention, it just can't be ignored. From the beautiful lines and the way it shines, you can't go wrong by choosing a Solstice timepiece. 100M WATER-RESISTANT STAINLESS STEEL: Comes with scratch-resistant Sapphire Crystal Glass used for the best clarity & protection of the beautiful dial. 42 mm case, 10.3 mm thick, 22mm band width & 100m water resistant. TELL TIME WITH PRECISION & RELIABILITY: equipped with the well-known Miyota quartz Japanese movement used on many brands. Don't worry about winding or re-setting your watch, continuous time telling for excellent reliability for years to come. SHARP CRISP EDGES perfect for any occasion: Casual, Formal, Dress, Sport, or everyday wear. brush finished case and band with a polished bezel & edges for extra shine and design. It comes with a beautiful watch box, making it an excellent present for yourself or a loved one with this luxury timepiece. watches.name: The Revival Automatic: Ice Blue
watches.description: The Revival Line masterfully blends enduring sophistication with versatility. It's captivating designs resonate with collectors and enthusiasts, embodying an irresistible allure that transcends fleeting trends. Versatility takes center stage, with seamlessly transitioning from any occasion to another. Featuring a famous aesthetic, the integrated bracelet design and effortlessly swappable straps offer a customizable luxury tailoring to your individual style, delivering exceptional value without compromise. Specifications Size: 40mm Height: 10.5mm Lug-to-Lug: 46.5mm Water Resistance: 10 ATM (100m) Movement: Sellita SW200-1 / Automatic Power Reserve: 38 hours No of Jewels: 26 Complication Type: Date Vibrations: 28,800 p/hr (4Hz) Timing Tolerance: +/- 15 sec p/day Strap Width: 24mm to 18mm Strap Material: Stainless steel & Leather Case Material: Stainless steel Watch Model: Revival 40 Features Half link included for precise micro-adjustments. Quick release tabs - interchangeable strap system. Butterfly clasp & folding deployment clasp. Brushed and polished stainless steel case. Embossed Crown and Crown guards. Open caseback. Anti-reflective sapphire crystal. Three-dimensional original dial design. Swiss Super-LumiNova® BWG9. Marine-grade stainless steel integrated bracelet. Stylish watch box, 2 straps, half link, link tool.

specsRaw.Perfect for any occasion: Casual, Formal, Dress, Sport, or everyday wear. Brush finished case and band with polished detailed edges for extra shine and design.
specsRaw.With every purchase: an extra swappable leather strap, half link for micro adjustments & link removal tool packaged in a luxurious, stylish watch box
